window.MTC.ready.then(() => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 450))).then(() => 'es: ' + (() => { const out = []; for (const svg of document.querySelectorAll('.pdoc__diagram')) { if (getComputedStyle(svg).display === 'none') continue; const vb = svg.viewBox.baseVal; for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll('text')) { if (t.closest('.dg-badge')) continue; const b = t.getBBox(); if (b.x < vb.x - 1 || b.y < vb.y - 1 || b.x + b.width > vb.x + vb.width + 1 || b.y + b.height > vb.y + vb.height + 1) out.push('fuera del viewBox: ' + t.textContent); const boxes = [...svg.querySelectorAll('rect.dg-box, rect.dg-frame, rect.dg-pill, rect.dg-fill-accent')]; const host = boxes.filter((r) => { const rb = r.getBBox(); const cx = b.x + b.width / 2, cy = b.y + b.height / 2; return cx > rb.x && cx < rb.x + rb.width && cy > rb.y && cy < rb.y + rb.height; }).sort((p, q) => p.getBBox().width * p.getBBox().height - q.getBBox().width * q.getBBox().height)[0]; if (host) { const rb = host.getBBox(); if (b.x < rb.x + 2 || b.x + b.width > rb.x + rb.width - 2) out.push(svg.classList[2] + ' «' + t.textContent + '» toca el borde de su caja (' + Math.round(b.x) + '–' + Math.round(b.x + b.width) + ' en ' + Math.round(rb.x) + '–' + Math.round(rb.x + rb.width) + ')'); } } } return JSON.stringify(out); })())
